title: Freezer Compartment Sensor Fault
shortDescription: The freezer temperature sensor is reporting an invalid reading.
fullDescription:
E1 indicates the control has detected an open or shorted thermistor in the freezer compartment. The unit typically falls back to a default run pattern and can over- or under-cool.

Frost accumulation around the sensor, a damaged harness, or a failed thermistor are the usual causes.

Replace the sensor after verifying its resistance with a multimeter.

fixSteps.title: Defrost area
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug and let the freezer defrost fully before inspecting the sensor.

fixSteps.title: Test sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Measure thermistor resistance against Whirlpool temperature chart.

fixSteps.title: Replace sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Install new thermistor and reconnect harness.

whenToCallPro: Call a pro if the sensor replacement does not resolve the code.

faq.q: Will food spoil while E1 shows?
faq.a: Possibly. Monitor freezer temp with an external thermometer until repaired.

title: Evaporator Sensor Fault
shortDescription: The evaporator coil sensor is out of range.
fullDescription:
E2 reports an open or shorted evaporator thermistor. The control uses this sensor to decide when to run defrost cycles; without it, heavy frost can build up.

Test the thermistor at the coil. Replace if resistance is out of spec.

fixSteps.title: Access evaporator
fixSteps.instruction: Remove rear panel inside the freezer after defrosting.

fixSteps.title: Replace thermistor
fixSteps.instruction: Swap in the new sensor and reconnect the harness.

whenToCallPro: Call a pro if frost returns quickly after sensor replacement.
videoSearchQuery: Whirlpool freezer E2 evaporator sensor fix

faq.q: Why does frost return after fixing E2?
faq.a: Check the defrost heater and the defrost thermostat — they share the same circuit.

title: Defrost Cycle Fault
shortDescription: The defrost cycle did not complete correctly.
fullDescription:
E3 is displayed when the evaporator does not warm up sufficiently during a defrost cycle within the expected time. This typically points to a failed defrost heater, bimetal thermostat, or open fuse.

Frost on the evaporator coils and poor cooling usually accompany this code.

fixSteps.title: Manual defrost
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug and let the freezer defrost completely, 8-12 hours.

fixSteps.title: Test heater and thermostat
fixSteps.instruction: Check continuity of defrost heater and bimetal thermostat.

fixSteps.title: Replace failed parts
fixSteps.instruction: Replace whichever part fails the continuity test.

whenToCallPro: Call a pro if coils remain iced after replacement — the sealed system may be affected.

faq.q: Can I skip the manual defrost?
faq.a: No. Parts testing and access require the coils to be clear.

title: Fan Motor Fault
shortDescription: The evaporator or condenser fan is not spinning correctly.
fullDescription:
FE appears when the control cannot confirm the correct RPM from the freezer fan motor. Ice buildup, a seized bearing, or a failed driver board are the typical causes.

Remove any obvious ice obstruction and test the fan by spinning it by hand.

fixSteps.title: Clear ice
fixSteps.instruction: Defrost the freezer fully to remove ice around the fan.

fixSteps.title: Replace fan motor
fixSteps.instruction: Install new evaporator fan motor if it does not spin freely.

whenToCallPro: Call a pro if the fan is free but FE persists — the control board may be at fault.
videoSearchQuery: Whirlpool freezer FE fan error fix

faq.q: Can I keep using the freezer with FE?
faq.a: Short-term only — food temperature will drift without proper airflow.

title: Over-Temperature Alarm
shortDescription: Freezer temperature has risen above the safety threshold.
fullDescription:
OE (over-temperature) activates when the freezer has exceeded approximately 15 F (-9 C) for a sustained period. Recent loading of warm food, a left-open door, or a cooling failure are typical causes.

If the freezer has been running normally and OE appears, investigate airflow blockages and sealed system performance.

fixSteps.title: Close door
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure the door is fully sealed and gasket is clean.

fixSteps.title: Silence alarm
fixSteps.instruction: Press the alarm-reset button on the control panel.

fixSteps.title: Monitor recovery
fixSteps.instruction: Verify temperature drops below -0 F within 8 hours.

whenToCallPro: Call a pro if the freezer does not cool back down within 24 hours.
videoSearchQuery: Whirlpool freezer OE over temperature fix

faq.a: If items are firmly frozen (solid) they are safe to refreeze. Thawed raw protein should be cooked or discarded.

title: Communication Error
shortDescription: The main control and UI boards have lost communication.
fullDescription:
C1 means the user-interface board and the main control board are not exchanging data. This often appears after a power surge or if a harness has become unseated.

Power cycle first, then inspect the harness if the code returns.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug 5 minutes and restore power.

fixSteps.title: Reseat harness
fixSteps.instruction: Open control area and reseat ribbon cables between boards.

whenToCallPro: Call a pro if reseating harnesses does not resolve C1.
videoSearchQuery: Whirlpool freezer C1 communication error fix

faq.q: Does the freezer still cool with C1?
faq.a: Sometimes yes, in a default run mode, but you cannot adjust settings.

title: Condenser Fan Fault
shortDescription: The condenser fan is not running at the expected speed.
fullDescription:
C2 reports a fault in the condenser fan circuit — often a failed motor or obstructed blade. A noisy fan usually precedes this code.

Vacuum the condenser area and verify the fan spins freely before replacing the motor.

fixSteps.title: Clean condenser
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug and vacuum the condenser and fan area.

fixSteps.title: Replace fan motor
fixSteps.instruction: Install a new condenser fan motor if it will not spin freely.

whenToCallPro: Call a pro if the compressor stays hot after fan replacement.

title: Door Open Alarm
shortDescription: The freezer door has been detected open for too long.
fullDescription:
dE activates when the door switch reports an open door for more than about 5 minutes. In most cases, simply closing the door clears it.

If dE appears with the door closed, the door switch or magnetic reed sensor may be failing.

fixSteps.title: Close door
fixSteps.instruction: Check nothing is blocking the seal.

fixSteps.title: Test door switch
fixSteps.instruction: With a multimeter, verify the switch reads closed when magnet is near.

whenToCallPro: Call a pro if replacing the switch does not resolve the code.
videoSearchQuery: Whirlpool freezer dE door error fix

faq.q: Will the light stay on with dE?
faq.a: Yes, the interior light stays on, accelerating temperature rise.

title: Control Lock Active
fullDescription:
LOC indicates control lock (child lock) is active. This is not a fault — it prevents accidental button presses.

Hold the Lock button for 3 seconds to unlock.

fixSteps.title: Unlock
fixSteps.instruction: Press and hold Lock (or Control Lock) for 3 seconds.

videoSearchQuery: Whirlpool freezer LOC control lock unlock

faq.q: Why does LOC turn on by itself?
faq.a: It usually doesn't — verify no one has leaned on the button.

title: Power Outage Indicator
shortDescription: A power outage was detected during operation.
fullDescription:
PO (or PF on some models) informs the user that a power interruption occurred. The freezer resumes normal operation once power returns but flags PO so the user can verify food safety.

Press any button to clear the indicator. If it returns without an outage, the control may have an intermittent power connection.

fixSteps.title: Acknowledge code
fixSteps.instruction: Press any button to dismiss PO.

fixSteps.title: Inspect outlet
fixSteps.instruction: If PO recurs, test the outlet and cord for intermittent connection.

whenToCallPro: Call an electrician if the outlet tests unstable.
videoSearchQuery: Whirlpool freezer PO power outage indicator

faq.q: Is food still safe after PO?
faq.a: Check the freezer temp. Food is safe if still solidly frozen or at 40 F or below.
